Dialogs.Dialog: Did you come visit me knowing today's my birthday？
I can get my hopes up today, right？ After all, it's my birthday... hehe.
Hey, it's my birthday, so we get to spend it just the two of us, right？
Happy birthday. Let me celebrate properly for you, okay？
Happy birthday. Maybe I'll do whatever you ask of me today？
Happy birthday! I'll spoil you as much as you want today.
Do you remember the day we first met？ Today's our anniversary.
Today's the anniversary of when we first met. You remember, of course？
Should we celebrate today？ It's the anniversary of when we first met, after all.
Today is... the special anniversary of when we became a couple▼
Today's our anniversary of becoming a couple. You remembered, right▼
Hey, today's the day we became a couple... want to have a special celebration？
Well, it's Monday. And so a brand-new week begins~
It's Tuesday. Come on, we've gotta give it our best.
Mmm, only Wednesday, huh. Ah, I let myself slack a little there.
Thursday. Feels like we've made it over the hump for the week, doesn't it？
Friday's finally here. Doesn't it make you a little excited？
It's Saturday, you know？ It's such a relief.
The Sunday we've waited for! I won't let you just laze the day away, okay？
It's warm during the day, but mornings and nights get chilly. Look after yourself.
When it's this hot, staying hydrated and well-fed is super important, okay？
It smelled like autumn this morning. Hehe.
It's cold out. Want to snuggle up？
I just felt so happy all of a sudden... hehe.
I'm so glad. You came to see me.
I was waiting for you to come by.
Hurry, hurry! We want as much time together as we can get, right？
Seeing you always makes me so happy.
Hey, how much did you want to see me？
When you're not around... I feel so lonely.
Isn't there some way we could see each other even more？
Hehe... so what are your plans from here on？
What are you planning to do now？
Making me wait this long... you're such a bad boy.
I thought you'd come soon, so I got all ready.
If you say you're happy to see me, maybe I'll pat your head like a good boy.
There, there. Did you miss me？ I wanted to see you, too.
I got a little tired of waiting, so maybe I'll act a little spoiled to make up for it？
While I was waiting, I couldn't stop thinking about you.
Happy New Year! Another year together starts today♪
I always forget my first dream, so I wrote this year's down. No peeking, okay？
If I'm in your first dream... I'll take full responsibility and make you happy.
Besides you, what else is lucky to see in a first dream, I wonder？ Hehe.
You know what day today is, don't you？ I'm so excited, too.
What comes to mind on February 14th？ Hehe... you're hoping for something, aren't you？
Happy Valentine's! Should I spoil you rotten today？
Today's March 14th... Ah, not that I'm trying to drop hints or anything!
For my White Day gift... how about you do whatever I tell you to？
Today is White Day! Maybe I'll expect something from my boyfriend？
Why don't you tell me a lie that'll make me swoon？
It's April Fools', so... maybe I'll let you fool me？
To tell the truth, I got held back a year... Just kidding! April Fools!
A field trip with everyone is always so exciting, no matter how old you get.
I wonder if I'll sing well at the choir contest？
It's Tanabata. If you could only see me once a year... what would you do？
It's the Towano Festival. Would it make you happy if I wore a yukata？
Today's Sports Day. Maybe I'll give it everything I've got？
Trick or treat! Looks like there's a little troublemaker right here, too？ Hehe.
Looks like there'll be some fun events at the school festival today, you know？
Today is Christmas Eve. I really want us to be together, just the two of us...
Have you thought about plans for today？ It's Eve, so of course you're with me, right？
It'll definitely be fun, spending Eve with me. Go on, picture it？
A year goes by so fast. Is it because I'm with you that it feels that way？
How did the exams go？ Aaah, I'm so nervous...
My birthday's coming up soon... For my present, I want you... Hehe, that doesn't make much sense, does it？
Your birthday's coming up soon, right？ I'm so excited. Hurry up and grow up, okay？
It's almost the anniversary of when we became a couple. ...Are you happy right now？
Valentine's is getting close. There are so many cute chocolates, I can't decide!
Mmh, White Day is almost here. Spring's right around the corner, too♪
It's almost April Fools', you know？ What kind of lie do you want me to tell？
The field trip is coming up. Will you be too excited to sleep the night before？
The choir contest is almost here, right？ I wonder what song we'll sing...
Tanabata is coming up soon, so should we put some decorations in your room？
The Towano Festival is coming up soon, right？ I'd love to go on a festival date with you.
Sports Day is almost here. I'm expecting big things from you♪
Halloween is coming up, are you dressing up？ As for me... Hm？ Do you want to see me in costume？
The school festival is finally getting close. Let's do our best preparing!
That big event for couples, Christmas, is getting closer... Hehe♪
Not much left of this year. Doing a countdown together sounds wonderful, doesn't it？
Exams are coming up soon... *Sigh*, better do my best.
Hey？ Make sure you look forward to tomorrow, okay？
Tomorrow is... wait, never mind. It's nothing.
Guess what day tomorrow is？ Fufu.
Ready for our date today？ No being late, okay？
Come on, it's date time! Hurry, hurry♪
I'm so looking forward to our date tomorrow. Fufu.
What do you feel like eating most right now？ I might even take requests？
This town changes so fast. Change brings excitement, but it feels a little lonely, too, doesn't it？
I heard a new shop opened. Want to go check it out together？
Do you know any hot spots right now？ Let's check together.
I've noticed you haven't texted me lately... It's pretty lonely...
Why haven't you texted me lately？ Are you pouting about something？
Hey, do you not like texting me？ You haven't sent a thing lately.
We haven't seen each other at all lately. Aren't we dating... isn't this weird...？
We haven't seen each other lately, but you don't even seem to mind？
Seeing each other this rarely... I really hate it...
We haven't been kissing much lately... Is it my fault, I wonder...？
Why won't you kiss me？ We're dating, aren't we？
Do you not like kissing me？ Because I... your kisses...
Are you not feeling well？ I'm worried... Don't push yourself, okay？
Looks like your studies are going well lately. I'm very impressed.
Full of curiosity, huh？ Don't forget to study up on your girlfriend, too♪
Working hard on workouts？ You seem a little more manly lately.
You look like you're in great shape. A guy with good stamina is pretty attractive.
Your taste has improved! Maybe I'll brag about my boyfriend to my friends？
How should I put it... you seem really perceptive？ I like it.
It's great you're getting so charming, but... don't go looking at other girls, okay？
You just keep getting cooler and cooler. Hehe... I love you so much♪
Fufu. It's still February, so that counts, right？
Were you really, truly looking forward to seeing us？
